title: Hyphen
description:
Simple to understand. Brutal to master.In Hyphen, you must guide a constantly rotating stick through a series of intricate neon mazes. Avoid walls, dodge obstacles, outmanoeuvre enemies and survive the traps standing between you and the finish line.

It may sound simple, but every movement demands timing, precision and patience. One small mistake can send you straight back to the beginning, turning each completed section into a hard earned victory.

Hyphen is designed for players who enjoy a genuine challenge. It can be tense, frustrating and infuriating - but finally conquering a level that once seemed impossible makes it all worthwhile.

And when you've conquered the campaign, the challenge doesn't have to end. Create your own levels with Hyphen's Level Editor, share them through Steam Workshop, and take on Community Levels created by other players. Whether you want to build something clever, creative or downright cruel, the same tools used to create new Hyphen content are now in your hands.

Accompanied by glowing neon visuals and an energetic original soundtrack, Hyphen delivers a fast, fluid and intensely addictive test of skill - with an ever growing collection of community made challenges waiting beyond the main campaign.

Features• 36 challenging campaign levels filled with obstacles, enemies and traps

• A powerful Level Editor for creating your own Hyphen challenges

• Full Steam Workshop integration — create, share and discover player-made levels

• Community Levels let you take on challenges created by other players

• A fast-paced 11-track original soundtrack composed by Andrew Lloyd

• Unlockable bonus minigames

• Support for keyboard and controllers

• Simple controls with demanding, precision-based gameplay

• Vibrant neon visuals

Hyphen is ideal for fans of classics such as Irritating Stick and Kuru Kuru Kururin. We have increased the intensity and taken a no-nonsense approach to the level design, creating a game for players who are not afraid of a serious challenge.

Beat the campaign. Master the impossible. Then create something even worse for everyone else.

Do you have the patience, precision and determination to reach the end?
description_short: Guide a constantly spinning stick through intricate neon mazes in this fast, fluid and highly challenging action/puzzle game. Turn up the volume, sharpen your reflexes and spin your way to victory!
